definitions.explanation: A metal fastener with a spiral thread.
The mechanism for winding a clock or watch.

ねじ⟦{回|まわ}し→回す：01158_mawasu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。

notes:
ねじ has two main uses: a metal fastener with a spiral thread (screw), and the winding mechanism on clocks or toys. Also written as {螺子|ねじ} or ネジ in katakana.

COMMON PATTERNS (screw):
- ねじ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{締|し}める→締める：10057_shimeru⟧ (to tighten a screw)
- ねじ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{緩|ゆる}める→緩める：15263_yurumeru⟧ (to loosen a screw)
- ねじ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧ (to remove a screw)
- ねじ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{固定|こてい}する→固定：10996_kotei⟧ (to fasten with screws)
- ⟦ねじ{回|まわ}し→ねじ回し：06503_nejimawashi⟧ (screwdriver)

COMMON PATTERNS (winding):
- ねじ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧ (to wind a clock/toy)
- ⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ねじ (clock's winding mechanism)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ねじ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{外|はず}れている→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧ (to have a screw loose — be eccentric/crazy)
- ねじ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧ (to tighten up discipline, to put pressure on someone)

COUNTER:
Screws are counted with ⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧: ねじ⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧ (one screw).
